concepts.title: Average Speed of a Journey
concepts.definition: Average speed spreads the whole path length evenly over the whole duration of the trip; it ignores direction because it is a scalar quantity.
concepts.key_idea: Add every kilometre travelled, divide by every hour spent, never subtract for turning back.

concepts.title: Average Velocity on Closed Paths
concepts.definition: Average velocity uses displacement, the straight gap between start and finish with its direction, divided by the time taken; on a trip that ends where it began the displacement vanishes, so the velocity is zero even when the speed is not.
concepts.key_idea: Speed counts the path, velocity counts only the net change of position.

concepts.title: Work-Time Efficiency and Combined Work
concepts.definition: A worker who finishes a job in d days performs 1/d of the job per day, so efficiency is the flip side of time: doubling the efficiency halves the days. Rates of workers simply add.
concepts.key_idea: Turn each person into a per-day fraction, add the fractions, then invert.

concepts.title: Pipes and Cisterns Net Filling
concepts.definition: An inlet pours 1/fill_h of the tank per hour and an outlet drains 1/drain_h per hour; the tank fills at the difference of the two rates, and the filling time is the reciprocal of that net rate.
concepts.key_idea: Same arithmetic as combined work, except the outlet carries a minus sign.

concepts.title: Calendar Odd Days and Weekday Codes
concepts.definition: Days left over after complete weeks are odd days; an ordinary year leaves 1 and a leap year leaves 2. Counting the odd days of a span and reducing them modulo 7 maps 0 to Sunday, 1 to Monday and so on, so any date can be decoded from a reference day.
concepts.key_idea: One odd day per ordinary year, two per leap year, then read the remainder mod 7.

solution_steps.action: count the ordinary years in the span
solution_steps.explain: leap years are removed from the total span first

solution_steps.action: one odd day per ordinary year plus two per leap year
solution_steps.explain: 365 leaves 1, 366 leaves 2 after whole weeks

solution_steps.action: reduce the odd days modulo the 7-day week
solution_steps.explain: the remainder indexes the weekday with 0 as Sunday

concepts.title: Clock Hand Angles and Relative Speed
concepts.definition: The minute hand sweeps 6 degrees each minute and the hour hand only half a degree, so the minute hand gains 5.5 degrees per minute. The angle between the hands at h hours m minutes comes from the hour mark spacing of 30 degrees, keeping the smaller of the two possible angles.
concepts.key_idea: Each hour mark is 30 degrees; the minute hand runs 5.5 degrees per minute faster.

concepts.title: Surface Area of Combined Solids
concepts.definition: When two basic solids are joined, only the surfaces you can still see are counted; the faces glued together are hidden inside and drop out. A tent of a cone on a cylinder therefore costs the cone's curved area plus the cylinder's curved area.
concepts.formula: area = pi * r * slant + 2 * pi * r * h
concepts.key_idea: Add the visible curved pieces only; the joint circle is never painted.

solution_steps.explain: the joint circle is internal and excluded

concepts.title: Volume of Combined Solids
concepts.definition: Unlike surface area, volume keeps everything: a joined solid holds the sum of its parts, so a cone-on-cylinder tent stores one-third pi r squared times the cone height plus pi r squared times the cylinder height.
concepts.formula: vol = pi * r ** 2 * cone_h / 3 + pi * r ** 2 * cyl_h
concepts.key_idea: Hidden faces cut area but not capacity; capacities always add.

solution_steps.explain: base area times the cylinder height

concepts.title: Positive and Negative Work
concepts.definition: Work equals force times the displacement measured along the force: motion with the force earns positive work, motion against it earns negative work, and motion perpendicular to it earns none. Net work is the algebraic sum, so opposing contributions cancel part of the total.
concepts.key_idea: Give every push a sign from its direction; then just add the signed amounts.

solution_steps.explain: force times displacement along the force is positive here

solution_steps.action: combine with the opposing contribution as a signed amount
solution_steps.explain: the resisting work arrives as a negative input, perpendicular cases arrive as 0
